author: Imp-65
quote: I don’t understand what’s supposed to be fun about this game You steal cars  get chased by the police and do gang missions and heists just like in previous installments The only real change is that they’ve added more realism  which somehow makes the gameplay even more boring repetitive and unoriginal especially when compared to Cyberpunk And just like the previous game it has a terrible story It’s a huge disappointment that it received a 99 from biased reviewers I’d be equally disappointed if it won Game of the Year It doesn’t even deserve a nomination
